entities.name: Query protein 375 aa
observations: Sequence length is 375 aa; estimated molecular mass is 42.8 kDa and theoretical pI is 9.54.
The N-terminal soluble region contains Pfam Glycos_transf_2 (PF00535) at residues 44–155, plus overlapping Glyco_tranf_2_3 and Glyco_tranf_2_2 signatures.
The C-terminal region is strongly hydrophobic and consistent with a multi-pass membrane anchor/domain.
The sequence is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q4L977, annotated as 4,4'-diaponeurosporenoate glycosyltransferase.

entities.name: Q4L977
observations: Reviewed Staphylococcus haemolyticus protein; exact sequence match to the query with 100% identity and 100% coverage.
Annotated as 4,4'-diaponeurosporenoate glycosyltransferase involved in staphyloxanthin biosynthesis.
Annotated as a cell-membrane, multi-pass membrane protein.

entities.name: Q2FDU4
observations: Reviewed Staphylococcus aureus homolog with 45.5% identity and approximately complete coverage to the query.
Annotated as 4,4'-diaponeurosporenoate glycosyltransferase and plasma-membrane glucosyltransferase.

entities.name: Staphyloxanthin biosynthesis
observations: The protein catalyzes esterification of glucose to 4,4'-diaponeurosporenoate, forming glycosyl-4,4'-diaponeurosporenate as a step in staphyloxanthin biosynthesis.
